scripts.check: biome check . && bun run licences:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run coverage:sg-rules && bun run openapi:check && bun run docs:build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/sg-rules && tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/core/testing && tsc -p packages/ui && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p e2e && tsc -p apps/docs && tsc -p packages/demo && tsc -p packages/demo/tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p apps/demo && tsc -p apps/demo/tsconfig.node.json
scripts.e2e: bun run --cwd apps/web build && playwright test
scripts.demo:e2e: bun run --cwd apps/demo build && playwright test -c e2e/demo/playwright.demo.config.ts
scripts.dev: bun run --cwd apps/server dev & bun run --cwd apps/web dev; wait
